            This was one of my toughest and most researched purchase till date. I was scared to buy it based on the reviews and videos I found out this phone. But this was the only phone which met my specifications like 12 gb ram, 256gb space, Premium built, good camera even though I don't use it much, smooth performance with better screen hz than my old phone, and finally better batter backup. I had to make a call between this phone, s21 ultra and rog 5. The second one was too expensive and the last one was not available for purchase yet. So I had to go for this but was not sure if I had made the right choice. Also I did not get the phone till my last day of delivery but finally got it. Even after I got it was not sure if my phone is a good one or bad as whatbi have seen in reviews. But now after 2 weeks of usage I can say for sure that my choice was good. Charging is fast I mean really fast. I matter of minutes it charges to 100. Battery performance is awesome like gaming or browsing continuously for 6-7 hours without any hassle and once I keep it for charging like for minutes it have for another 6-7 hours. I am not tech savvy so not sure what's the difference between 60-120 hz display but I feel much smoother than my 6t which is 60hz I think. Camera, I haven't used it much but takes decent pictures and i loved how it takes pictures at night without flash. Don't know which camera from the 4 cameras given takes the picture but it's good and fun. Front camera is good for video calling and meetings. Because of the mask usage the face recognition is not doing a good work as it does recognise my face with a mask which is good work just to prove its doing its work correctly. But I am very happy how the on-screen finger lock works. It's fast. Much faster that the 6t which I have been using. Brightness is great and adjusts very good even during afternoon under the sun or pitch dark while sleeping and browsing YouTube. Overall it's a good buy. Don't know about the rest of the reviews but this is a Pretty good phone and a good upgrade from its predecessor.

          • RonyBlaze
            5 out of 5 stars
            BEST FLAGSHIP FOR THE PRICE RANGE
            Reviewed in India on 22 April 2021
            Verified Purchase
            Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
            Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

            THE MOST UNDERAPPRECIATED CELLPHONE IN AMAZON WHICH NEEDS MORE LOVE THAN 1 STAR

            RATINGS

            I am writing this review after reading all the negative reviews on this cellphone and I bought this even after reading the negative reviews. The reason being, all the bad publicity the cellphone was getting is because of its heating issue and heating issue only. If you are a smartphone user you will know that the

            company will release an update to counter these issues eventually. All the major companies have this problem but they get resolved within the 1st month of the release. Now I would like to say the even I have faced the abnormal heating issue while charging for the first time but after updating to Oxygen OS

            11.2.3.3 LE15DA which was immediately available all the heating issue has gone(at the time of this review 11.2.4.4 LE15DA is released for even better battery performance). The rest of the aspects is just why this cellphone makes the best phone in the market as on date (for me at-least). I am using the OnePlus Pro 12GB variant.

            Why you should buy this cellphone

             The camera is Amazing: I want to highlight the best at the beginning because we all know why we are buying this cellphone (mainly because of the Hasselblad branding).Yes you can compare the pictures taken with this cellphone with IPhone 12 or Samsung S21 (pro ultra whatever their top tiers are named) I won’t compare the MegaPixels as it is known universally better MegaPixel doesn’t always mean better photos. The main thing you need to see here is its color reproduction. It is almost to the colors as seen by you which is great for the price you are paying.The front camera also is good but the main highlight is the main camera and the wide angle camera.

             The LTPO display: It is said that the cellphone uses the LTPO display which varies the screen refresh rate between 1Hz to 120Hz on the type of app you are viewing, I haven’t personally seen it drop below 60Hz but it is said it helps reduce the battery drain. But FHD+ display is just beautiful to look at. Smooth, responsive and Bright. All the traits needed for a good display.

             IP68 rating: The OnePlus Pro comes with water resistance and there isn’t much to talk about it here.

             Warp Charge: The cellphone charges from 0-100% in 30 minutes with the 65Watt charging brick available in the box. Yes there is a charger in the Box. If you are interested in buying the 50w wireless charger that will take 40 mins for full charge from 0.

             Oxygen OS: The near stock OS is such a good move by the company as you don’t get any

            additional bloatware or ad hungry apps (which are rampant in Xiaomi cellphones). Everything is simple and easy to access.

             Speed: Snapdragon 888 with 12 GB of RAM makes this cellphone one of the top contender in the current cellphone market. All the games run smooth. No lag what so ever. I play

            COD:Mobile and Free fire which run without lag at max settings.

             Speakers: The audio output of the cellphone is clear and loud and sounds really premium.

            Things that need Improvement:

             Battery: Although you get a fast charging capability. The battery drain is too rapid. It is not bad but full charge lasts around 4-5 hours of heavy usage and for a cellphone which is flagship should have better stability.

             No 3.5mm port for headphone jack. This is not a major issue as most of the users are now using wireless earphones but it would be really nice for gamers to have this option.

             Placement of Fingerprint scanner: Too low that’s all I have to say. The scanner is top notch as the response time is lightning fast. But the placement is too low to be called comfortable.

            Ultimately this cellphone is the best at its price range I can’t stress this enough. When comparing other flagships which cost you around Rs.105000/- (Samsung, Apple) you invest Rs.70000/- and you get almost the same specs along with charger. One suggestion from me is please go for OnePlus Red Cable membership it costs around Rs.2000/- and gives you 1 year additional warranty along with other benefits (just a suggestion).

            I would give this phone 4.5 out of 5 Stars.I would like to end it with this one message “To all the people who review any product and give a poor rating just because of one flaw (a flaw that can be corrected eventually). Please mention the other aspects too (the ones you liked) as the company, developers and

            all the people involved in the process of manufacture and sales of the product put a lot of love and effort into the release of the product and just because of the poor rating people will miss out on a great

            product “this cellphone needs all the love from the consumer.

            Pros:

            * Phone design is premium

            * Phone front camera has good clarity and takes detailed pictures

            * Display looks awesome and 128Hz refresh rate allows smooth navigation, browsing & animation.

            * Didn't hang at all in my medium usage

            * No display hardware issues like its predecessor oneplus 8 model (that is why I waited for next model for buying)

            Unit at service center and onplus give this solution

            Hello Amit! Thanks for reverting back to OnePlus support and we are extremely sorry for the inconveneince caused. Knowing that your experience has not been pleasant makes us concerned and we wouldn't want you to be dissatisfied.

            However, as the issue still persists post the repair service, In this case, to appropriately support you through this kindly submit the logs to the OnePlus community so that the developers can investigate the matter further and get in touch with your towards a resolve.

            Steps to submit logs:

            1. Log into Community app

            2. Sign up with your OnePlus account.

            3. Look out for the "+" symbol and tap on it.

            4. Click on Feedback option/Google option.

            5. Select the issue category and answer the related questions

            6. At the end of the page click on Start recording to generate logs.

            7. Minimize the app and reproduce the issue and take screenshot at the time of occurrence.

            8. Go back to the app and stop recording.

            9. Finally click on "Submit " to share the log files.

            Note :After sharing the feedback, please delete the Oem_log file and folder from your Device in the File manager or it will occupy more Storage Space.

            Meanwhile, you may also reset your device to further troubleshoot and check if your issue gets resolved. Note: Before performing the hard reset, request you to please remove your Google account from the settings on your device and back up your device data as further steps will wipe(delete) the complete data from your phone.

            Step 1:Power off the device and press the volume down and power buttons simultaneously for 15-20 seconds

            Step 2:Select the Language as "English".

            Step 3:The recovery screen will appear on the display

            Step 4:Select "Wipe data & cache"

            Step 5:You will have three options stating “Reset system settings”, “Erase everything” and “Wipe cache”

            Step 6:Select “Erase everything”

            Step 7:Select “Yes”

            Step 8:Select “Reboot”

            We apprecaite your kind understanding in this regard.

          • Reshma M J
            3 out of 5 stars
            Not that happy now!
            Reviewed in India on 3 April 2021
            Verified Purchase
            Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
            Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

            Really happy about this purchase. Camera is really amazing. So much options to choose. The display is also smooth and satisfying to use. (I wrote this on the day I received the phone)

            Edits: (after 3 days of using it)

            I have been using this phone for 3 days. I am changing my rating from 5 to 3 for the following reasons.

            1. Heating issue: it heats very fast and when it's heated, camera doesn't work. This happened when I tried to take some clicks outdoors in the morning.

            2. Front camera is not worth for this money. Any regular mobile can have the same quality.

            3. No 3.5mm port which was kind of disappointing.

            4. They said camera's quality is close to human eye. But the photos are far from reality. The photos have more colours than in real and gives a more brighter picture. I don't hate it but they shouldn't have given false advertising.

            Apart from this, the pros I found are

            •Fast charging

            •More display options including Screen off Gestures which is very helpful.

            •Smooth display

            •Gaming mode is good. Performance wise is also good.

            From three days use, I conclude that this phone is overpriced. This can be sold for maximum 50k. Anyhow,most problems can be solved with software updates. I will change my ratings once they release any such update.
